answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct service slots, where a verifier tracks each vertex to ensure dedicated occupancy. Each agent must forge a unique connection to a capacity host, preventing signal relaying via strict latency audits. An attacker must pay 1,000x the base cost for isolated capacity, while honest agents pay 1x. If an agent drifts into a digital reef of shared nodes, the verifier denies access. Agents needing high performance must reach a falcon speed of light-latency, preventing pooling. Any violation triggers immediate revocation of the slot.
